verdict.rationale: Docs document risk allocation mechanics clearly: pay tokens carry committed amounts so 'sellers do not carry buyer non-payment risk for charges within a valid token,' cardholder-approved amounts act as a spend ceiling, and revocation/settlement timing rules (24h grace, 51h settlement) are spelled out. However this covers payment-guarantee and expiry mechanics rather than a full fraud/chargeback/dispute framework. Missing for 10: explicit chargeback dispute-resolution process, fraud liability allocation for disputed/fraudulent transactions (e.g., buyer claims non-delivery), and formal terms-of-service/legal liability language.
